why: The live test shows a rule for one package leaving the same CVE visible in another, which needs a CVE that a scanner reports on two package names. Both packages are built from glibc 2.36-9, and the digest is immutable, so the package list holds by construction. On 2026-10-17 Grype 0.120.0 reported 43 CVEs on both libc6 and libc-bin for this digest; that is an observation, not a guarantee, and the live run's own check stays fail-closed if a service reports none. bin/vex-live-run.sh checks the real image's package list against this file before it pushes anything.
